queries.bright:
SELECT TOP 50000
  source_id, ra, dec, parallax, pmra, pmdec, phot_g_mean_mag, bp_rp
FROM gaiadr3.gaia_source
WHERE ra IS NOT NULL
  AND dec IS NOT NULL
  AND phot_g_mean_mag IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY phot_g_mean_mag ASC
queries.density:
SELECT
  source_id, ra, dec, parallax, pmra, pmdec, phot_g_mean_mag, bp_rp
FROM gaiadr3.gaia_source
WHERE random_index < 150000
  AND ra IS NOT NULL
  AND dec IS NOT NULL
  AND phot_g_mean_mag IS NOT NULL
